  --judge-mode <both|independent|pairwise>                           Judge mode: pairwise, independent, or both [default: pairwise]
  --runs <runs>                                                      Number of runs per scenario for averaging [default: 5]
  --parallel-skills <parallel-skills>                                Max concurrent skills to evaluate [default: 3]
  --parallel-scenarios <parallel-scenarios>                          Max concurrent scenarios per skill [default: 3]
  --parallel-runs <parallel-runs>                                    Max concurrent runs per scenario [default: 3]
  --judge-timeout <judge-timeout>                                    Judge timeout in seconds [default: 300]
  --confidence-level <confidence-level>                              Confidence level for statistical intervals (0-1) [default: 0.95]
  --results-dir <results-dir>                                        Directory to save results to [default: .skill-validator-results]
  --tests-dir <tests-dir> (REQUIRED)                                 Directory containing test subdirectories
  --reporter <reporter>                                              Reporter (console, json, junit, markdown). Can be repeated.
  --no-overfitting-check                                             Disable LLM-based overfitting analysis (on by default)
  --overfitting-fix                                                  Generate a fixed eval.yaml with improved rubric items/assertions
  --keep-sessions                                                    Preserve agent session data in the results directory for later rejudging
  --noise-skills-dir <noise-skills-dir>                              Directory containing skills to load as noise. Enables the noise test: re-runs scenarios with all noise skills loaded and measures degradation.
  --noise-max-degradation <noise-max-degradation>                    Maximum acceptable average quality degradation (0-1) in noise test (only positive degradations count) [default: 0.2]
  --noise-max-scenario-degradation <noise-max-scenario-degradation>  Maximum acceptable quality degradation (0-1) for any single noise-test scenario [default: 0.4]
  --baseline-out <baseline-out>                                      After running, persist each scenario's averaged baseline (no-skill/no-agent reference) to this file for later reuse with --baseline-from.
  --baseline-from <baseline-from>                                    Reuse a precomputed baseline from this file instead of re-running the no-skill/no-agent baseline arm.   -?, -h, --help                                                     Show help and usage information

  rejudge <results-dir>  Re-run judges on saved sessions without re-running agents
  consolidate <files>    Consolidate multiple results.json files into a single markdown summary

scenarios:
  - name: "Add a health check endpoint to a plain .NET 10 web API"
    prompt: |
      I have a bare .NET 10 web API project with no source files yet.
      Add a Program.cs that configures the app with a health check endpoint at /healthz
      using the built-in ASP.NET Core health checks middleware. Also add a basic
      GET /api/status endpoint that returns the current UTC time as JSON.
    setup:
      copy_test_files: true
    assertions:
      - type: "file_exists"
        path: "Program.cs"
      - type: "output_contains"
        value: "AddHealthChecks"
      - type: "output_contains"
        value: "MapHealthChecks"
      - type: "output_matches"
        pattern: "(MapGet|app\\.Map)"
      - type: "output_contains"
        value: "UtcNow"
    rubric:
      - "Created a Program.cs using top-level statements and minimal API style"
      - "Registered health checks with builder.Services.AddHealthChecks()"
      - "Mapped health checks to /healthz with app.MapHealthChecks()"
      - "Added a GET /api/status endpoint returning the current UTC time"
      - "Used DateTimeOffset.UtcNow or DateTime.UtcNow, not DateTime.Now"
    timeout: 120

  - name: "Add structured logging and exception handling to a .NET 10 web API"
    prompt: |
      This is an empty .NET 10 web API project. Set it up with:
      1. A Program.cs with proper exception handling using IExceptionHandler
      2. ProblemDetails responses for all errors
      3. Structured logging that includes the request path and correlation ID

      Don't add any external NuGet packages beyond what the SDK provides.
    setup:
      copy_test_files: true
    assertions:
      - type: "file_exists"
        path: "Program.cs"
      - type: "output_contains"
        value: "IExceptionHandler"
      - type: "output_contains"
        value: "ProblemDetails"
      - type: "output_contains"
        value: "AddProblemDetails"
    rubric:
      - "Implements IExceptionHandler for global exception handling"
      - "Configures ProblemDetails with AddProblemDetails()"
      - "Uses structured logging with LoggerMessage or ILogger with template parameters (not string interpolation)"
      - "Includes correlation ID propagation (e.g., via Activity.Current or a custom header)"
      - "Does not add any NuGet packages beyond the web SDK"
    timeout: 120

  - name: "Add a CRUD API with dependency injection to a .NET 10 web API"
    prompt: |
      I have a bare .NET 10 web API project (PlainApi.csproj targeting net10.0).
      Add a complete CRUD API for managing "Todo" items with these fields:
      - Id (int)
      - Title (string, required)
      - IsComplete (bool)
      - CreatedAt (DateTimeOffset)

      Use minimal APIs, an in-memory store behind an interface, and proper
      HTTP semantics (201 for create, 404 for missing items).
    setup:
      copy_test_files: true
    assertions:
      - type: "file_exists"
        path: "Program.cs"
      - type: "output_matches"
        pattern: "(MapGet|MapPost|MapPut|MapDelete)"
      - type: "output_matches"
        pattern: "(interface|ITodo)"
      - type: "output_contains"
        value: "TypedResults"
      - type: "output_contains"
        value: "DateTimeOffset"
    rubric:
      - "Uses minimal APIs with MapGet, MapPost, MapPut, and MapDelete"
      - "Returns TypedResults with proper HTTP status codes (Created, Ok, NotFound, NoContent)"
      - "Defines a service interface and registers the implementation via DI"
      - "Uses DateTimeOffset for the CreatedAt timestamp, not DateTime"
      - "POST returns 201 Created with a Location header, not 200 OK"
      - "Model and DTOs are records or have sealed classes"
    timeout: 180
